notes.text: The linked passage has Rabbi Yonatan son of Rabbi Elazar recount what Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakonia said about the thirty-nine labors. Yose is named as Shimon’s father. [Heilprin’s Lakonia entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2376&lang=en) likewise lists Yose as Lakonia’s son.
